descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
Tasks
Define, maintain, and execute the overall testing strategy across releases and teams.
Design, develop, and maintain automated E2E test suites using Playwright/Cypress.
Plan, execute, and monitor smoke, regression, and functional testing activities.
Create and manage test plans, test cases, and test execution cycles in Xray.
Integrate automated tests into GitHub CI/CD pipelines and ensure quality gates.
Track, analyze, and report defects while collaborating with development teams on issue resolution.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement sessions, and release planning.
Maintain testing documentation, quality metrics, and reporting in Jira and Confluence. 
 Qualifications
 Must-haves:
Extensive experience in QA Automation and software testing.
Extensive experience with Playwright or Cypress for End-to-End test automation.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript or Java for test automation and E2E test development.
Strong test management experience using Xray.
Solid experience defining and maintaining testing strategies in Agile/SAFe environments.
Experience with GitHub and CI/CD pipeline integration.
Experience creating and executing Test Plans and Test Executions.
Experience with smoke, regression, functional, and performance testing.
Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, or similar).
Jira and Confluence knowledge.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is an advantage. 
 Nice-to-haves:
Experience testing Angular-based applications.
Experience with API testing and automation.
Knowledge of AWS cloud environments.
Experience with performance and load testing tools.
Experience working in SAFe Agile Release Trains.
ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
Experience with AI-powered tools, such as Claude or similar solutions.
Experience in enterprise applications, preferably in the Automotive domain (Aftersales, Diagnostics, etc.) is a plus. 
 Things to know before departure:
Start: by arrangement - always on the 1st and 15th of the month
Working hours: full-time (40h); 27 vacation days
Employment contract: CIM, Unlimited
Line of work: Consulting
Language skills: Fluency in written and spoken English; German is nice to have
Flexibility & willingness to travel
Other: a valid work permit
